`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and uses it to flatten `n.model.parameters.snapshots`, but never converts the local `sns` passed to the variable and constraint builders. For a MultiIndex network with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), those builders still receive the original MultiIndex; the component-data context does not change that argument, regardless of the transmission-loss setting.
